tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// 'phags pa tshogs bdag dkar po jo bo lugs kyi rjes gnang bya tshul gsal ba zhig bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ tshogs bdag dkar po'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas/ skar ma rgyal gyi dus su gnas dben par rdul tshon gyi sa gzhi gru bzhi'i dbus su padma 'dab brgyad dkar po bris pa'am/ maṇḍal la tshom bu gcig dgod/ sku yang bzhugs su gsol/ mthar mchod pas bskor/ gtor ma rgyan ldan che ba gcig bsham/ rang kha byang du phyogs la stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro nas 'byung ba'i 'byung 'dul gyi bsgom bzlas tshogs bdag dmar chen gyi skabs ltar bya bar gsungs pas/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis 'byung po 'dul byed du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang 'byung po 'dul byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes sogs chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs nas haṃ zhes brjod pas gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ paṃ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang pos rdo rje ba dan rtse gsum dang ldan pa dang*/

g.yon dang pos thod khrag lcang lo dang ldan pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis mda' gzhu rgyab nas 'gengs pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ ha ha'i gad rgyang gis sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu sgra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ mi ro'i steng na zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa la/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par mos la tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ 'bar ba'i sku can nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi// dpa' bo'i stangs stabs zhabs kyis sa 'og g.yo// rab tu khros pa'i khro gnyer glog stong 'khyug /dpal chen 'byung po'i dgra la phyag 'tshal lo// bzhad pa'i nga ros sum cu rtsa gsum 'jigs// kun tu thogs med gdug pa'i mtshon cha bsnams// snying rje'i dbang gis zhi zhing 'gro la brtse// dngos grub stsol mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis myang*/

rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas rang la thim par bsams la/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badzra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas pa'i mthar 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim par bsam/ de nas mdun gyi tshom bu sumbhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ gaḥyig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dkar po glang po che'i zhal can/ phyag bzhi pa g.yas dang pos la phug lo ma dang bcas pa/ gnyis pas dgra st+wa/ g.yon gyi dang pos ka pā la nor bus gang ba/ gnyis pas rtse gsum rnams 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che zhing mi'u thung gi gzugs can zla tshes kyi cod pan dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ byi ba sngon po'i gdan la phyed krung gis bzhugs pa'o// de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i steng du gaḥyig shel dkar po ltar 'od 'phro ba de las 'od 'phros pas ri rab kyi steng sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po nor lha'i 'khor gyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ glang po'i phyag rgya dam tshig gi phyag rgyar bstan la sngags gsum po lan gcig brjod/

de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas mtshan sngags re re bzhin sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod shabdas mchod la/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje// gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i// tshogs rje tshogs dbang tshogs kyi bdag /bgegs kyi gtso la mchod cing bstod// me tog la sogs mchod pa dang*// la du la sogs mthun rdzas kyis// bgegs rgyal tshogs bdag 'khor bcas mchod// dngos grub thams cad bdag la stsol// zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma sumbhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar/ oṃ zhu ba las gtor ma 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ oṃ bhrūm̐ ga ṇa pa ti ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe sogs nas ba liṃ te swā hā/ lan gsum mam lngas phul la mchod bstod 'dod don gsol gdab bya/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros mdun bskyed kyi tshogs bdag 'khor bcas la phog pas de'i thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros te/ khams gsum gyi 'gro ba zas nor thams cad dbang du bsdus nas rang la thim zhing gdon bgegs bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas par bsams la/ oṃ wa ra ta ka swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so// oṃ wa ka te ka daṣṭī bhindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ snying po'o// oṃ bhrūm̐ ga ṇa pa ta ye swā hā/ mtshan sngags te bsnyen pa byed na gsum ga la 'bum phrag gsum re bzla bar gsungs la/ 'dir ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar dpal tshogs kyi bdag pos bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas rjes gnang zhu bar 'dod pa'i slob ma ji ltar rigs pa gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkram bsdu bya/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du rjes gnang zab mo zhu snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la chos ldan gyi 'tsho bas mi phongs par bya ba'i phyir nor lha khyad par du 'phags pa dpal tshogs kyi bdag po zhes bya ba 'di nyid la rigs mang du yod pa las/ da res 'dir jo bo chen po nas brgyud pa'i bka' gdams lugs kyi tshogs bdag dkar po'i rjes gnang zab mo sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams sngon du song nas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ thog mar slob dpon la dpal phyag na rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig phul mdzod/ maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo bdag la dgongs su gsol// lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po yi// lha yi dpal ni thob bya'i phyir// bdag la bka' drin gnang bar mdzod// rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir du rgyun bshags bya dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sogs chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin gtibs pa bzhin bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum brjod/ de nas rjes gnang dngos la/ sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba/ phrin las gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba rnams su yod pa las/ sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams skye mched kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid gaḥyig shel dkar po dri ma med pa lta bur yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams dpal tshogs kyi bdag po zhes pa nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar bya/

de brtan par bya ba'i ched du tshogs bdag gi sku slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag cing*/ bu 'di dkyil 'khor chen po ru// sngon du legs par zhugs zin gyi// lha chen 'di la dgongs su gsol// lha chen 'di la stsal lags kyi// lha chen 'di la brtan bzhugs nas// lha yi dpal ni stsal du gsol// 'di la bgegs ni med par mdzod// oṃ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti kā ya siddhi oṃ/ zhes brjod/ sku las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ lus kyi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byas/ sku'i rjes gnang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i don du slob dpon gyi thugs kar lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po bzhugs par dmigs/ de'i thugs kar gaḥyig dkar po'i mthar sngags phreng las bzhi gang sgrub pa'i kha dog can gyis bskor ba las/ sngags phreng 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams lha chen tshogs kyi bdag por gsal ba'i sna nas zhugs/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar lan dang pos 'khod/ gnyis pas byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas brtan par bsams la/ sngags gsum po'i rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir nang mchod oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa de nas slob ma la byin la/ lha chen dgyes pa'i dam tshig 'di// dngos grub bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun te// btung ba rin po che 'di ni// gsang ba'i dngos grub rdzas su bsngags// dpal dang gzi brjid bskyed pa'i phyir// bu khyod kyis ni myang bar gyis// oṃ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti wāka siddhi āḥzhes brjod/ de ltar byas pas ngag gi bar chad zhi bar byas/ gsung gi rjes gnang ma lus pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po las de 'dra ba zhig mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byon te/

khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de brtan par bya ba'i don du me tog gtor zhing*/ lha chen mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs// 'di yi rjes su 'jug par mdzod// 'di yi rjes su zhugs nas kyang*// byin rlabs dngos grub char ltar phob// oṃ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de ltar byas pas sems kyi bar chad zhi bar byas/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ma lus pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas phrin las gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba la/ slob dpon gyis gtor ma lag tu bzung nas/ gtor ma 'di nyid dpal tshogs kyi bdag por gsal ba'i steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ mtha' skor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha thams cad kyis bskor nas sprin gtibs pa bzhin bzhugs pa la/ rtsa ba'i bla mas bka' bsgos pa'i dus su brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bka' bsgos pas/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rang rnams la 'bral med du bzhugs nas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i phrin las mdzad pa yin snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dpal phyag na rdo rje/ jo bo chen po/ dpal ldan dgon pa ba/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ sprul sku bya yul ba/ gtsang pa rin po che/ pha sangs rgyas sgom pa ba/ zem rin po che/ khams pa lung pa/ sangs rgyas jo bo/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa gsar ma/ rin po che bcu bzhi pa/ rin po che tshes bcu pa/ spyan snga grags she ba/ lo pa tshul dar/ rin chen bsod nams lha'i dbang po/ rgyal sras ngag dbang chos grags/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i bka' las ma 'da' bar lha chen po khyod kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang*/ khams gsum dbang du bsdus nas/ zas gos longs spyod thams cad la phongs pa med cing*/

des kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod/ ces brjod cing*/ gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag la sngags rnams kyi mthar a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭhi te hūm̐ zhes pa dang*/ gtor ma lha chen por gsal ba 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim par mos pa mdzod byas nas gtor ma nas cung zad bcad de slob ma rnams la sbyin nas zar gzhug de brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ 'di yis khams gsum ma lus pa// dbang du sdud par byed pa yi// rtags su dbang gi thig le gdab// dbang gi rgya 'dis brgyan par gyis// gaḥbargyad dang sarba ratna siddhi hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gi'u wang dang tsandan dmar po'i phye mas slob ma'i dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga rnams su thig le bya/ des rjes gnang ma lus pa thob nas spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ gtso bos sogs/ maṇḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi 'gro ltar ro// de nas slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa kha gso/ byin rlabs byas la/ oṃ bhrūm̐ ga ṇa pa ti sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag pos bdag dang sems can thams cad chos dang ldan pa'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badzra satwa sogs yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma 'byor pa sogs nongs pa bzod par gsol/ sku la brtan bzhugs bya/ rang gnas bsrung*/ dge ba bsngo zhing shis pa brjod/ las rjes bsdu'o// zhes pa 'di ni bco brgyad chos rje'i bkas bskul nas/ dge slong she'u lo tsā bas yig rnying la zhib tu brtags nas bkod pa yin la/ 'dir mi gsal ba gzhan nas rigs 'gre sbyar ba la/ slad nas yig cha gsal ba dang*/ phyag len khungs thub mthong na dpyad par bya'o// 'dis 'gro ba mang po la phan par gyur cig brgyud pa'i kha skong ni/

rgyal sras ngag dbang chos grags nas/ she'u lo tsā ba kun dga' chos grags/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa chen kun dga' blo gros/ kun dga' mkhas grub dbang po/ rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ des bdag 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la'o// //sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
